title: Our process
description: From enquiry and design through approval, production and delivery: the SFP project process.

title.html: From your idea. To the finished object.

body.html: Five clear steps. Personal guidance throughout.

media.alt: Material and design study: olive and taupe leather trays on wood

body.html: We discuss the application, product idea, quantity and required delivery. Together, these define the scope for materials, specification and quotation.

media.alt: Consultation scene: two people compare leather samples and discuss a project brief

body.html: Form, material, colour and branding become tangible. Technical layouts and project-specific samples help assess tactility and proportions before production.

media.alt: Sample development: a leather tray beside its design drawing and material swatches

body.html: We record the agreed specification. Approvals, commercial terms and the production schedule are confirmed before manufacturing begins.

media.alt: Approving a specification using a tray sample, material and technical drawing

body.html: Your accessories are handmade in the EU. The specification approved together provides the basis for production and for checking the details.

media.alt: Making and quality control: leather stitching and checking material thickness with a caliper

body.html: We coordinate delivery and discuss any further requirements. For additions, we review the specification and current material availability with you.

media.alt: Leather accessories wrapped in tissue paper and prepared for delivery

body.html: Production can take 4–6 weeks after your approval. We agree the specific delivery date with you.
Where the product, materials and capacity allow, express orders are available for a surcharge, with delivery potentially in under two weeks. We confirm feasibility before you place the order.
For new customers, we request 100% payment in advance. For large orders from existing customers, we request a 50% advance payment. The agreed terms are set out in your quotation.
